mission: Build a sourceable mathematics corpus before pedagogy-specific literature is added.
collection_principles: Collect broad mathematical foundations before specialist literature.
Prefer standard references with stable notation and explicit definitions.
Store segment-level citations before extracting concepts or claims.
Treat pedagogy and psychology as a later, separate literature program.
Keep historical enrichment optional until the core reference base is stable.

domain_sequence.name: Arithmetic and Number Sense
domain_sequence.goal: Secure the base language of number, operation, ratio, and quantity.

domain_sequence.name: Algebra Foundations
domain_sequence.goal: Cover symbolic manipulation, equations, expressions, and structural patterns.

domain_sequence.name: Geometry and Measurement
domain_sequence.goal: Anchor spatial reasoning, shape, congruence, similarity, and measurement.

domain_sequence.name: Functions and Precalculus
domain_sequence.goal: Prepare the bridge from school algebra to calculus and modeling.

domain_sequence.name: Calculus and Analysis
domain_sequence.goal: Capture limits, derivatives, integrals, and rigorous analysis foundations.

domain_sequence.name: Linear Algebra
domain_sequence.goal: Store vectors, matrices, linear maps, spaces, eigen-ideas, and proofs.

domain_sequence.name: Discrete Mathematics
domain_sequence.goal: Cover logic, combinatorics, graphs, recurrence, and proof technique.

domain_sequence.name: Probability and Statistics
domain_sequence.goal: Provide the foundation for uncertainty, inference, and data reasoning.

domain_sequence.name: Differential Equations
domain_sequence.goal: Link calculus foundations to dynamic systems and applications.

domain_sequence.name: Number Theory
domain_sequence.goal: Cover divisibility, congruences, prime structure, and classical results.

domain_sequence.name: Abstract Algebra
domain_sequence.goal: Model groups, rings, fields, homomorphisms, and algebraic structure.

domain_sequence.name: Topology and Advanced Geometry
domain_sequence.goal: Extend the corpus toward advanced pure mathematics.

source_families.name: Historical Primary Works
source_families.role: Origin tracing and historically grounded claims.

source_families.name: Modern Standard Textbooks
source_families.role: Stable mainstream reference base for definitions and theorem statements.

source_families.name: Problem Collections
source_families.role: Worked examples, exercises, and difficulty ladders.

source_families.name: Survey and Reference Texts
source_families.role: Topic overviews, canonical summaries, and cross-links.

source_families.name: Curriculum References
source_families.role: Mapping concepts to school and university progression.

starter_collection_queue.output_expectation: High-confidence school-to-precalculus corpus with segment-level citations.
Proof-friendly corpus for formal reasoning and misconception detection.
Continuity from intuitive calculus explanations to rigorous analysis.
Introductory-to-intermediate probability and statistics reference set.
Expansion path toward advanced pure mathematics and historical provenance.
